name: v0.3.13 suspended-parent nested sequence stack
one_shot_semantics: After this protocol commit and the later candidate-freeze commit, run the 18-cell mechanism matrix once, then the preregistered regression cells once. Rerun only an exact cell that fails for infrastructure reasons. Do not change frame fields, unwind semantics, restoration, budgets, or targets after the first target evaluation.
research_question: Can nested branch starts retain their normal child-sequence exploration semantics while the outer sequence is suspended rather than discarded?
success_means: Protocol integrity and reproducible evidence on inspected cases. Not a fresh-generalization claim.

when_all: chosen action is a branch click
an outer sequence instance is open
do: snapshot the active sequence frame before the nested action is applied
push that frame on a LIFO stack
start the nested branch as a normal historical child sequence
give the child its own active_branch, the nested hub as parent, BRANCH_HORIZON commitment, a branch_start event, structural-memory attempt accounting, and a new sequence instance
leave the nested click out of the outer commitment and the outer sequence_action count
restore the immediate outer frame only after the active child completes by the historical successful parent match
do_not: emit lost_parent for the suspended outer
flatten the child click into the outer sequence
decrement outer commitment for the child branch click
restore an outer frame when the child only emitted finding or crash
restore an outer frame after return_cycle_escape
count a resume as return_success, branch completion, or branch_start

sequence_local.active_branch: the branch key the suspended sequence was executing
sequence_local.parent_hub_sig: exact signature the suspended sequence must return to
sequence_local.commitment_left: remaining commitment before the child click; the child click does not decrement it
sequence_local.returning: whether that frame was already in return phase; suspension requires this to be false
sequence_local.branch_actions: action count local to that sequence; historical branch start resets it
sequence_local.branch_new_states: new-state count local to that sequence
sequence_local.branch_findings: finding count local to that sequence
sequence_local._seq_len: sequence length counter local to that sequence
sequence_local._open_instance: id, branch, and len of that sequence instance
sequence_local._seen_failed_return_dests: exact destinations already seen in that frame's unresolved return phase

global_not_snapshotted.ledger.hubs: discovered, started, completed, and returned sets are cross-sequence branch memory
global_not_snapshotted.aggregate counters: started_total, completed_total, return_attempts, return_success, mutations, followup_actions, sequences_started, sequences_completed, seq_lens, repeats
global_not_snapshotted.StructuralHubMemory: global structural attempt and context memory; a real child branch start records an attempt
global_not_snapshotted._last_delta: not cleared on historical branch start
global_not_snapshotted._tried_action_ctx: not cleared on historical branch start
global_not_snapshotted.mutations: TTL list is not cleared on branch start and follow-up matching ignores branch_id, so it stays global

frame_fields.mutation_decision: Mutations stay global. Child follow-up during the child commitment therefore sees the same mutation list a v0.3.9 guard child would see after lost_parent. Resume does not rewind the list.

restoration_rule.when: The active child's historical _complete_branch runs because the new signature matches the child's recorded parent signature or parent cluster.
restoration_rule.accounting: Child returned or prior finding/crash terminal, completed/returned branch accounting, and return_success increment happen exactly once on the historical path.
then: emit parent_frame_resumed with resumed branch, resumed parent hub, remaining commitment, completed child branch, stack depth after pop, and resumed sequence instance id
restoration_rule.finding: A finding terminal does not pop. The outer stays suspended until the child return obligation resolves.
restoration_rule.crash: A crash terminal does not pop. Later historical parent match may resume. Escape or budget end does not pretend the crash was a return.

unwind_rule.when: The active child emits return_cycle_escape. The child did not return to its parent.
do: keep the historical child escape accounting exactly once
emit sequence_terminal outcome=nested_descendant_abandoned for each still-open suspended instance

budget_end_rule.active_open_instance: one budget_end terminal if still open

reset_rule: reset() clears the active controller, the return-cycle destination set, the suspended stack, and candidate counters. Stack depth is 0. No suspended parent resumes. No old destination set remains.

terminal_accounting.rule: Every sequence instance that emitted branch_start has exactly one sequence_terminal.
terminal_accounting.lost_parent_scope: lost_parent remains legal only when the suspension predicate is false. A commitment-window lost_parent is a failed repair, not an accounting violation by itself.
terminal_accounting.violation: zero terminals, more than one terminal, or an outcome outside the legal set

matrix.purpose: G shows historical preemption. F shows flattening. S tests the stack.

all: S emits at least one nested child stack event (parent_frame_suspended or nested_child_started)
S reaches at least one horizon or a finding, crash, or returned terminal
S reaches return phase or a child return resume
S states > G states OR S normalized URLs > G URLs

safety_tests.P1: one-level suspend starts a real child and does not emit lost_parent
safety_tests.P2: suspended outer commitment stays at the pre-child value; child commitment after its branch action is BRANCH_HORIZON - 1
safety_tests.P3: child successful return pops one frame and restores the same outer instance and commitment without an extra outer completion
safety_tests.P4: resumed outer can continue to its own horizon and return to its own parent
safety_tests.P5: two nesting levels restore LIFO: grandchild return resumes child, child return resumes outer
safety_tests.P6: one finding terminal; outer stays suspended until the child parent match
safety_tests.P7: finding then cycle escape unwinds ancestors and does not resume or double-terminal
safety_tests.P8: child return-cycle escape abandons the child and unwinds the stack with zero false returns
safety_tests.P9: crash terminal alone does not restore the outer
safety_tests.P10: budget end accounts for the active open instance and every suspended open instance once
safety_tests.P11: reset clears the stack and return-cycle history
safety_tests.P12: child branch start is a real structural attempt and is not later scored as untried
safety_tests.P13: with no suspension, candidate events match the v0.3.9 guard
safety_tests.P14: frame-local exact-destination sets do not contaminate each other
safety_tests.P15: every started instance has exactly one legal terminal
safety_tests.N1_N12: historical v0.3.12 candidate tests, unchanged and still about flattening
safety_tests.exhaustive: bounded return model, at least 5800 traces, zero failures

outcome_gates.priority: C, then D, then B, else A

A.label: stack repair succeeds and removes v0.3.12 regressions
A.meaning: nested-stack mechanism repairs inspected preemption and removes the observed flattening regressions on historical regression cases
all: BuggyDesk loses zero reference-guard confirmed bugs
DeepBench loses zero reference-guard confirmed bugs
Wiki loses zero reference-guard confirmed bugs
BuggyShop loses zero reference-guard confirmed bugs
no false returned or completed inflation

B.label: mechanism works but regression repair is incomplete
B.when: Safety and terminal accounting pass, both CRM and Ops structural repair gates pass, and one or more reference-guard confirmed bugs remain lost, with every such loss inside the v0.3.12 regression-lost set and no harmful lifecycle violation.

C.label: harmful / unsafe
any: parent restoration without physical child return
a lost reference-guard bug outside the v0.3.12 regression-lost set

D.label: stack mechanism does not repair inspected preemption
D.when: No harmful condition holds, and CRM or Ops fails the structural repair gate.
D.not: Do not reinterpret D as A or B.

git_phase_gates.analysis: experiment: record v0.3.13 nested-stack regression analysis
